title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Numbers 14: Israel's rebellion after the spies' report, Moses' plea, the forty years in the wilderness, and the defeat at Hormah.

questions.text: What did the people say to one another after the spies' report?
questions.explanation: They said to one another, "Let's choose a leader, and let's return into Egypt."

answers.text: "Let's go up and fight at once"
"Let's choose a leader, and return into Egypt"
"Let's send new spies into the land"
"Let's build a city in the wilderness"

questions.text: What did Joshua and Caleb do when the people wanted to return to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who had spied out the land, tore their clothes.

questions.text: What did Joshua and Caleb say the people of the land were for Israel?
questions.explanation: They said, "Don't fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us."

questions.text: How did the congregation respond to Joshua and Caleb?
questions.explanation: All the congregation threatened to stone them with stones, and Yahweh's glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: They sent them back to Egypt

questions.text: Who did Moses say would hear it if Yahweh struck down the people?
questions.explanation: Moses said to Yahweh, "Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them."

questions.text: How many times did Yahweh say those men had tempted him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said those who had seen his glory and signs had tempted him these ten times and had not listened to his voice.

questions.text: Why did Yahweh say he would bring Caleb into the land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said Caleb had another spirit with him and had followed him fully, so he would bring him into the land.

answers.text: Because he was the oldest of the twelve spies
Because he had another spirit and followed Yahweh fully
Because he was the prince of the tribe of Judah
Because he carried back the cluster of grapes

questions.text: Why would Israel bear their iniquities for forty years?
questions.explanation: The forty years matched the forty days in which they spied out the land: for every day a year.

answers.text: Because forty elders had rebelled against Moses
Because they had complained forty times
Because Moses had prayed for forty days
A year for each day they spied out the land

questions.text: What happened to the men who brought up an evil report of the land?
questions.explanation: Those men who brought up an evil report of the land died by the plague before Yahweh; only Joshua and Caleb remained alive.

answers.text: They were sent back to Egypt
They died by the plague before Yahweh
They were shut out of the camp for seven days

questions.text: How far did the Amalekites and Canaanites beat Israel down when they went up the mountain?
questions.explanation: The Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain struck them and beat them down, even to Hormah.
